tested: the federal rules: 27 CFR 5.145 (brandy alone is grape brandy; under two years in oak it must say immature; apple brandy may be called applejack) and 5.146 (blended applejack: at least 20 per cent apple brandy of two years in oak, at most 80 per cent neutral spirits, at least 80 proof). 1 search.

e-and-j: 1975 and the five years of trials at Fresno, brandy under another name from 1938, both brothers' dates, the VSOP Grand Blue's two years and tasting note, bourbon barrels (not found), the three months from fermentation to still. 4 searches.
